note: Bridger-Teton NF campground on the east bank of the Greys River, about 23 miles up the Greys River Road (FS-10138) from Alpine. The loop runs along the river; the Pearson Creek Trailhead, which begins with a river ford, is next to it. After the season the gate stays open and camping is free with water, toilets and trash off. --Claude
summary: FS page read: 10 sites, trailers to 30 ft, FCFS, 14-day limit, 2 vehicles, vault toilets, fee $10 / $18 both listed; no rec.gov listing. Riverfront kept on imagery (units ~8-12 m from the bank, scattered trees; channel ~28-34 m, borderline creekside). Phone empty -> 307-886-5300. Pin fine.
flags: WATERFRONT (checked hard): riverfront kept, borderline on width. On z19 imagery the loop's riverside sites (units at ~42.9725,-110.7712 and ~42.9723,-110.7710) are ~8-12 m from the Greys River across grass with only scattered single conifers. No site numbers are published (no site map, no rec.gov catalog), so the riverside sites can't be named. The channel measures ~28-34 m at the sites - at the ~30 m line; if AWH reads it under 30 m the value is creekside. All sites first-come, nightly.

WATER CONFLICT: the FS description says 'Potable water via a hand pump', but the same page's amenity block says 'Potable water is not available at this site.' Stored potable_water true (derived) left alone.

FEE: the FS page lists both '$10 per night' and '$18 per night' with no label; Greys River Corridor page says $10; a 2024 BTNF proposal was $10 -> $20 (outcome not found). Range 10-18 kept as written on the page.
STAY LIMIT: campground page says 14 days; the Greys River Corridor page and the forest-wide order say 16. 14 written (campground's own page).
SEASON: page gives only 'Seasons of Use May 1st' (no closing date; corridor page: main season Memorial Day - Labor Day); after closing the gate stays open and camping is free. Nothing written.
PHONE: empty -> 307-886-5300 (Greys River Ranger District, Afton; FS page). Website FS r04 page live, confirmed.
PIN: stored 42.97160,-110.76905 is at the entrance off FS-10138, ~170 m SE of the riverside sites (~42.9724,-110.7708) - under 250 m, no move; a better centre would be ~42.9724,-110.7708.
